Assess → Research → Plan → Approve → Execute → Verify → Document → Report → Monitor/Renew

## Stage definitions

### CRM and Sales

Capture → Enrich → Qualify → Discover → Scope → Quote → Follow up → Win/Lose

### Client Onboarding

Create/reuse client → Contacts → Agreement → Billing → Secure access → Knowledge → Kickoff

### Digital Marketing & Branding Delivery

Brand intake → Audit/research → Strategy → Campaign → Content/design → Approval → Distribution → Engagement → Analytics → Optimization

### Social Media Management

Onboard → Page setup/audit → Strategy → Calendar → Create → Approve → Publish → Engage → Analyze → Improve

### Website and Application Delivery

Discovery → Requirements → UX/content → Architecture → Build → QA/security → Preview → Approval → Deploy → Handover → Maintain

### AI and Workflow Automation

Process discovery → Baseline → Design → Permission review → Prototype → Test → Approve → Activate → Observe → Improve

### Infrastructure, Hosting and Domains

Inventory → Assess → Design → Provision → Configure → Secure → Verify → Monitor → Backup → Renew

### Email and Cloud Services

Requirements → Verify domain/tenant → Licence plan → Provision → DNS → Security → Migration → Test → Handover → Renew

### Managed IT and Support

Triage → Diagnose → Plan → Approve if risky → Resolve → Verify → Communicate → Document → Follow up

### Finance, Billing and Profitability

Quote → Acceptance → Invoice → Payment → Cost allocation → Profit → Reconcile → Report

### Renewals and Recurring Services

Schedule → Cost/price review → Reminder → Quote/invoice → Payment → Provider renewal → Verify → Next cycle

### Reporting and Continuous Improvement

Collect → Validate → Compare → Explain → Recommend → Approve → Feed next cycle
